subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in not more than 90 to
stimulus: 100 words. 10 Read the passage on the Geographical information of Sri Lanka, the Maldives and Bhutan: Sri Lanka is an Asian country. It is in South Asia. It is located in the Indian Ocean. Naturally it is very beautiful. Travellers from all over the world come here and spend a relaxed time. The total land area of Sri Lanka is 65,000 square kilometres. It is a land of different religions. Sri Lanka has a population of 20 million. The Maldives is also a South Asian country. It is a very small country. It is the smallest country in Asia. It lies in the Indian Ocean. It is an Island country. It is a good tourist destination. It looks like a pearl in the Indian Ocean. Its area is only 300 square kilometers. It is also the lowest country in the world. Bhutan is also a small country of South Asia. It is bordered with India and China. It is located in the slopes of the Himalayan range. Its land area is 38,394 square kilometres. It is the happiest country in Asia. It has a population of 7,16,896. It protects its environment and culture nationally.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Rajshahi Board-2016 (Test Paper 127-150)
